image_description: A group of four people in elaborate, theatrical costumes resembling Roman or mythological figures. The central figure is a woman wearing a golden, scale-like dress and a prominent, ornate golden breastplate with embossed details. To her left is a man in red and gold robes with white fur trim and a headdress. To her right is another person in a red robe with a monkey mask/headdress, and partially visible on the far right is a figure in heavy armor. The background suggests an outdoor setting with trees.
